feeds.title: IDIOTEQ » Post Hardcore
feeds.description: Independent magazine supporting DIY ethics & local artists. No-ads policy, giving space to deserving independent artists. Get inspired, explore lesser-known talents & their perspective. Reporting on DIY music is our priority.

feeds.title: Angry Metal Guy » Post-Hardcore
feeds.description: Metal Reviews, Interviews and General Angryness. AMG is the standard by which all should be judged, which is why he started a blog. Before sending promo read this post

feeds.title: A&R Factory » Post Hardcore
feeds.description: Since 2012, we have grown into one of the most respected artist and repertoire (A&R) blogs. We help music industry professionals discover new independent music from across the world.Their readership includes record labels, publishers, management companies, radio stations, pr and sync companies from across the world who use our website as a resource to discover and sign acts.

feeds.title: Sophie's Floorboard » Post-Hardcore
feeds.description: Sophie's Floorboard is a blog run by Kevin, featuring an extensive library of downloads and descriptions for US-based emo and hardcore bands, including screamo/post-hardcore bands. The blog is regularly updated with new content and also has a Spotify playlist. It can be followed on Facebook and Twitter for updates.

feeds.title: Noob Heavy » Post Hardcore
feeds.description: Noob Heavy is a blog dedicated to heavy music genres, including post-hardcore. It was founded by Carcassbomb in 2019 and features album reviews, interviews, and news. The blog supports underground and Australian metal bands and provides a platform for disadvantaged bands. The blog is managed by a global team passionate about heavy music, with Melinda (Carcassbomb) and Kep as editors and writers.

feeds.title: RIFF CULT » Post Hardcore
feeds.description: RIFF CULT is a cultural information site operated by RNR TOURS that disseminates various information about metal from around the world, including metalcore, deathcore, post-hardcore, brutal death metal, Djent, technical death metal, grindcore, gore. We provide a wide range of music information, from underground metal such as grind to rock and punk.

feeds.title: Distorted Sound Magazine » Post-Hardcore
feeds.description: Distorted Sound Magazine is the ultimate digital publication for rock and heavy metal enthusiasts, with a dedicated section for post-hardcore. Distorted Sound Magazine brings you the latest news, in-depth reviews, and exclusive interviews, ensuring you stay ahead.

feeds.title: Transcended Music Blog » Post-Hardcore
feeds.description: ENTHUSIASM FOR HEAVY MUSIC | UNRESTRICTED BY GENRE | UNDERGROUND ETHICS | REVIEWS | VINYL | TAPES

feeds.title: Unite Asia » Post Hardcore
feeds.description: The main inspiration of this website is the dearth of information about Asian bands and what they're up to. As someone who LOVES music I have always found it strange that every day I scour the world's huge database of punk/hardcore/metal websites such as Lambgoat, Punknews, Metal Injection, Dying Scene, In Effect, Double Cross, Legends Arising, The PRP, etc., and I am only ever able to read up on bands from the west (mainly USA). Personally, the music news that I ACTUALLY want to find out about is stuff going on around here in Asia.

feeds.title: New Transcendence » Post-Hardcore
feeds.description: I realized how much people enjoy and appreciate when people recognize them, even better when no one has heard of them. They also enjoy reading what other people have to say about music and the general idea/concept of what we do here. We want to let people know there are a lot of bands out there, who need the recognition that the main-streamers have acquired. Whether it be Facebook, YouTube, Blogspots, or just Google in general. People need to find ways to find music, and support the bands they discover.

feeds.title: Decibel Magazine » Post Hardcore
feeds.description: Decibel Magazine is the world's foremost heavy metal authority. Based in Philadelphia, PA, we have never deviated from our original mission of exploring the past, present and future of extreme music. Since our debut issue (October 2004), Decibel has exhibited an insatiable curiosity for all things heavy, covering both the underground and mainstream with painstaking obsession and irreverent humor.

feeds.title: Ear Nutrition » Post-Hardcore
feeds.description: Ear Nutrition is a blog dedicated to introducing guitar-driven new music across various genres, including post-hardcore. It offers introductions to new bands, album reviews, and news about upcoming events. The blog also features a series covering releases from the Punk and Alternative scene.

feeds.title: The Rock Revival » Punk & Post Hardcore
feeds.description: The Rock Revival is a website dedicated to rock and heavy metal music. It provides rock music news, reviews, live photos, and interviews. The site features updates on various bands and their upcoming tours, new song releases, and album review and more.

feeds.title: NefariousRealm » Post-Hardcore
feeds.description: Nefarious Realm is a Boston based media company focusing on music, art, film, and culture through alternative, mainstream, underground, and cvlt communities.

feeds.title: Dead Relatives » Post-Hardcore
feeds.description: Dead Relatives began as a web mag for artistic conversations in 2021. After our first year of publication, we started hosting semi-public parties & galleries involving Orange Amps, 22 West, UCLA Radio, & Audio-Technica. During this time, we built the infrastructure intended to carry our original concept for the mag our turn to print is live now.

feeds.title: AudioVein Entertainment » Post-Hardcore
feeds.description: AudioVein Entertainment provides 0% rumors, gossip, or unnecessary information. Everything you see on this site will be confirmed, factual, and to the point. You have complete access to choose any genre or subgenre you're interested in. We also incorporate other mediums of entertainment such as movies, games, TV, and more. This part is a work in progress, of course.
